mentions.name: Video Hub App
mentions.description: This app lets users browse, search, and organize their video collections on Windows, Mac, and Linux. It is MIT open source and is being ported from Electron to Tauri, shrinking the installer from about 400 MB to 40 MB.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Trying to port over Video Hub App from Electron to Tauri (400mb -> 40mb installer)

https://videohubapp.com/ - Browse, search, and organize your videos on Win, Mac, and Linux

https://github.com/whyboris/Video-Hub-App - MIT open source!

mentions.name: Video Hub App
mentions.description: A desktop application for browsing, searching, and organizing video collections stored on a computer, external hard drives, or network drives. The app is being ported from Electron to Tauri.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Porting over Video Hub App - my 8.5 year old app from Electron to Tauri

https://videohubapp.com/ - an application that lets you browse, search, organize, etc the videos you have on your computer, external hard drives, or network drives.
